changeSet.author: DM
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW student_view AS SELECT u.id AS user_id, r.course_id AS course_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, COALESCE(SUM(gi.grade)::numeric, 0) AS total_points FROM user_role r JOIN "user" u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN grade_item gi ON gi.user_id = u.id AND gi.course_id = r.course_id WHERE r.role_id = 5 GROUP BY u.id, r.course_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email;
